dedupe_keys.name: malawi master health facility registry extract february 2023 ministry of health via the health cluster on hdx

description: This dataset is an extract of Malawi's Master Health Facility Registry, the national online database of health facilities run by the Ministry of Health and Population. The registry replaced a spreadsheet list that was hard to update and parallel lists kept by different parts of the ministry, and offers a web interface, dashboard and custom queries at zipatala.health.gov.mw. The Health Cluster shared a copy dated 8 February 2023 on the Humanitarian Data Exchange as a zipped shapefile, an Excel table of facilities and a PDF master list. Files are free to download without registration under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Coverage is national and includes facilities of all ownership types listed in the registry. Caveats: HDX points to the official website for the current database, so the extract will age, and the fields must be read from the files. Simulation uses: complete national facility locations and attributes for health access, referral and disaster impact models in Malawi. Related records: the Malawi health facilities dataset built from the registry and DHIS2 (data-malawi-health-facilities-registry-dhis2) is a separate research extract focused on public fee-free facilities.
